stations.name: Aldershot GO

parking.overnight: GO customers may use an empty non-reserved space for up to 48 hours.

stations.roadAccess: Waterdown Road, close to Highway 403 and the QEW/403 split.
stations.bestFor: West Burlington, Waterdown-bound drivers, and anyone connecting to VIA.

stations.name: Burlington GO

parking.overnight: GO customers may use an empty non-reserved space for up to 48 hours.

stations.roadAccess: Fairview Street, between Brant Street and Guelph Line, with direct local-road access from central Burlington.
stations.bestFor: Central Burlington, downtown, and riders who want a garage and bike rooms.

stations.name: Appleby GO

parking.overnight: GO customers may use an empty non-reserved space for up to 48 hours.

stations.roadAccess: Fairview Street at Appleby Line, the eastern Burlington station on the Lakeshore West line.
stations.bestFor: East Burlington and riders coming from the Oakville side who want the largest free parking supply.
